name: Visual Verification
description: Screenshot the shared Browser session after a UI change and compare that visible state with what was requested.

permissionsRequired.reason: Capture the page after the change.
Tie the screenshot to the session URL and viewport.
Open the page when no shared session is on it yet.
Reach the changed screen in the same session.

validation.rule: A browser_screenshot from the shared session is cited. The UI is not called fixed from code inspection or an HTTP status.
